item.title: Breaking Triangles That Hurt Us And Harm Our Children
item.description: Breaking triangles means ending the harmful pattern where children are pulled into adult conflict to regulate anxiety or intimacy. When parents step out of triangulation, set boundaries, and face one another directly, children regain emotional safety—and adults reclaim the courage needed for real intimacy, healing generational trauma, and healthier relationships.

item.title: 12 Mysteries That Will Change Your Life
item.description: The 12 Mysteries are not answers to be memorized, but lived thresholds that reshape how we meet life. Each mystery reveals itself through experience—presence, loss, silence, change, and connection—inviting us to stop seeking certainty and begin living from awareness, truth, and inner maturity.
